title: Carry-Forward and Expiry Terms of the Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card
content:
An allowance on a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card belongs to the benefit period it was loaded for. Whether any part of it survives the end of that period, and how much, is a term of the tier.

| Card tier | An unspent allowance carries into the next period | Largest share of a period's load that may carry forward | An unspent allowance expires on | An unspent balance is forfeited when the health plan enrollment ends |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Core | no | 0 per cent | the last day of the benefit period in which it was loaded | yes |
| Select | no | 0 per cent | the last day of the benefit period in which it was loaded | yes |
| Plus | yes | 50 per cent | the last day of the benefit period after the one in which it was loaded | yes |
| Premier | yes | 100 per cent | the last day of the benefit period after the one in which it was loaded | yes |
| Dual Complete | yes | 100 per cent | the last day of the benefit year | yes |
| Chronic Care Plus | yes | 100 per cent | the last day of the benefit year | yes |

The same terms put as conditions. On a Core or Select programme nothing carries: an allowance loaded for a quarter is spendable to the last day of that quarter and no further. On a Plus programme up to half of a period's load may carry into the following period; on a Premier programme the whole of it may. On the Dual Complete and Chronic Care Plus programmes an unspent allowance stands to the last day of the benefit year.

Forfeiture on disenrollment is a term of every tier of the Supplemental Benefit Allowance Programmes without exception: on all six, an unspent balance is forfeited when the health plan enrollment that carried the card comes to an end.
